question: Is a fully aligned, history-disjoint 64-row bank with genuinely new temporal constructions natively capable enough for an unfiltered OOD test of the frozen v23 four-head circuit?
evidence_status: Prospective native-capability gate. The v23 capability and four-head confirmation are open. No v24 model outcome or intervention has been opened.

searched: all aspectual/is-was builders v1-v23 and their complete row, reporter, prompt, and construction inventories
all is/was capability gates through v23
the v23 aligned four-head confirmation result
prior_art.known_lessons: V23 established a selective aligned four-head circuit on its own lexical replication bank, but retained earlier target construction forms and licensed causal testing from target-only joint capability. A stronger OOD gate must change construction markers and freeze native capability for target and answer-preserving controls before any circuit result is opened.
prior_art.novelty: All 64 row IDs, all 16 reporter nouns, every prompt, and all eight construction markers are absent from v1-v23. A1 uses At the moment/In earlier years; A2 uses In current times/In past times; P uses At present day/In former days; C uses equal-length Inside the studio/Inside the clinic prompts. Every base/donor semantic endpoint remains exactly aligned.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides. Score every family-by-direction-by-side cell and the base-and-donor jointly correct population for every family; perform no interventions and no row selection.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder hash, row digest, full-history row/reporter/prompt/marker disjointness, construction checks, exact 16x4 inventory, and semantic-position equality pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_target_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least 0.75 and each target family has at least 12 of 16 jointly correct rows.
predictions.pred_c_native_control_capability: Every P/C direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least 0.75 and each control family has at least 12 of 16 jointly correct rows.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no v24 circuit outcome access.

decision: A-D pass licenses one separately preregistered, unfiltered v24 OOD four-head confirmation using all 64 rows. Any failure closes v24 without editing or filtering the bank and without testing the circuit.
